displayDescription: Backstage manga crew slide in a board and connect one idea into a system with staggered, role-specific actions.
audioDescription: Silent preview. No soundtrack, voice or effects; the sound crew's mixer action is a visual cue only.
limitations: Blender not used, per user instruction; scene is drawn with HTML/CSS and inline SVG and animated by one paused GSAP timeline.
Halftone is a stationary CSS/SVG dot pattern approximating screentone; no paper or ink material simulation.
Rough.js, PixiJS, Anime.js and Matter.js were not needed; contours are clean vector ink, matching the reference illustration.
STYLE.json has no reviewed preview recipes, so no recipe-specific refresh is demonstrated; the core style and a motion-012 board handoff are shown.
Rendering and browser seek checks are left to host QA.
